name: The Stockade
note: Read from the pinned core: the entrance is areatrigger 101 on map 0, a box rather than a radius, which areatrigger_teleport 101 sends to map 34; the bosses are DungeonEncounter.dbc's five encounters on map 34 in its order, each resolved to its creature_template entry and checked against a creature spawn on map 34, and instance_encounters names Bazil Thredd (1716) the instance's last encounter. Encounters only, so a boss fought as more than one creature names only its credited one, and nothing is marked optional because no source says a boss is off the route.
